diagnosis.conclusion: Arena cannot be certified for two retained 25-seat workshops while rhgnr1 repeatedly leaves Ready and participant routes fail.

red_green_matrix.red: Nine CPU seats failed on a one-shot model preflight.
red_green_matrix.green_local: Bounded retry and clean retry metadata passed the full non-local backend suite.
red_green_matrix.green_integration: The current backend image deployed Synced and Healthy.
red_green_matrix.green_live: The same workshop recovered from 16/25 to 25/25 without replacing ready sessions.

red_green_matrix.red: A 25-way CPU participant burst completed only 22 grounded journeys; the repeat burst failed all 25 route calls.
rhgnr1 entered NotReady twice during the retained rehearsal despite low CPU and memory utilization.
Namespace state diverged from 50 backend-ready sessions after the node incident; the deletion initiator is not yet proven.
Normal sequential reclaim and zero-residue proof must run after this failure snapshot is preserved.

proof_strategy.tdd: Preflight retry and stale-error removal were first expressed as failing tests and then made green.
proof_strategy.edd: The manifest retains immutable revisions, image digest, order IDs, participant results, node transitions, resource utilization, and lifecycle drift.
proof_strategy.cdd: The same-workshop retry contract preserved ready seats, recovered only incomplete seats, and cleared stale failure state.
proof_strategy.bdd: Given 50 retained participants, when 25 CPU learners execute together, then every route and grounded answer must succeed; this behavior failed.
proof_strategy.cbt: Provisioning recovery passed independently, while participant routes, node stability, lifecycle consistency, and cleanup remain separate failed or pending components.

required_next_actions: Reclaim the CPU Serving workshop and then the Multi-Agent workshop through their persisted Arena lifecycle paths.
Prove zero remaining namespaces and Argo CD applications for both workshop IDs.
Identify the namespace deletion initiator from audit evidence before the next rehearsal.
Hold rhgnr1 out of placement until a sustained stability soak passes.
Rebalance the September topology so one unstable worker cannot carry two 25-seat workshops.
